beats: The grammar lesson never matched what I'd just heard - it just came from wherever the textbook was.
Worse, it explained the rule, then jumped to a question - I'd end up reading the answer, not recalling it.
Now Claude builds the grammar break from the exact sentences I just heard.
It names my actual mistake out loud, contrasts it with the right form, then pauses before the answer plays.
That pause is a real 2.5 seconds - long enough to actually try to remember.
